name: Rock Spot Climbing Youth Adventure Programs (Lincoln, RI)
description_short: Week-long indoor and outdoor rock climbing programs for kids during summer and school vacations, booked through Rock Spot's Lincoln, RI gym (Providence gym camps also run through Lincoln). Indoor programs are for ages 6 and up, outdoor programs for ages 10 and up. All equipment is provided and no climbing experience is needed.

sources.note: Youth Adventure page: 'Providence, RI (run through Lincoln)', ages 6+ indoor / 10+ outdoor, Summer 2026 weeks from June 22; Lincoln schedule link
Lincoln, RI location page: 100 Higginson Ave, Lincoln, RI 02865, (401) 727-1704

warnings: The page only shows the Summer 2026 season. Those dates (starting the week of June 22, 2026) have already passed as of 2026-10-13, and there is no 2027 information.

This is a page for a chain of nine gyms (Malden, Brookline, South Boston and Boston-Dedham in MA; Lincoln, Providence and Peace Dale in RI; Wallingford and New Haven in CT). It is not one camp location. Each gym has its own schedule and phone number. Providence camps run through Lincoln, and New Haven camps run through Wallingford.
The only address shown is the corporate address (100 Higginson Ave, Lincoln, RI 02865), not a camp site. So no street address was recorded.
No specific session dates are listed. The page says only: 'Week-long programs start the week of June 22 and run every week until August.' Schedules are on each location's linked page.
